scope: A source-bound conditional request, exact transport, and independent replay using the installed canonical-ground native reader and qualified inference adapter.
authorship: Cases and expected outcomes were authored from the existing formal contracts before writing tests against the new source-binding and codec implementations. They are not generated by the production closure or classifier.
final_interface_decision: The first implementation accepts a source clause for the bridge and necessity relation, or null for a missing witness. It adds no caller-assumption branch. The earlier exploratory pilot runs without a bridge were used only to inspect full and clean source closure.

additional_acceptance_obligations: An independent expected request binds source bytes, query bytes, source identity, revision, scope, context, time, selected policy, typed conclusion, required roles, bridge and necessity relation; bundle fields alone cannot define the expected request.
A coherent replacement of both payload and all hashes must be rejected against the original expected request. A new request may be checked separately.
The source native answer, full closure, clean closure, qualified result and transport validity are separate outcomes.
Current evidence and budget are supplied independently during replay; an old successful receipt cannot restore a withdrawn premise or raise the new caller's budget.
The original native checker verifies the supplied certificate; missing certificate, missing checker, checker rejection or changed checker cannot fall back to an unchecked success.

The acceptance integration gate sets NABT_REQUIRE_MANTUQ_SOURCE_FOLD_NATIVE=1. Either unavailable or nonexecutable native checker must fail test-module loading instead of silently skipping native tests.
All relevant full counterevidence remains present. Every positively used requirement additionally needs a clean source derivation. No blanket rejection is inferred from an unrelated conflict.
A negative query is supported when that signed query is derived; native positive denotes query support, not a positive literal polarity.

The installed policy refusal for opposition by name or innama remains REFUTED for that application; a tainted supplied requirement must not replace the categorical policy refusal with DEFER. This refusal does not establish the negation of the proposed conclusion.
No supplied authority, adoption, empirical truth, closed-world absence or action permission is accepted from transport metadata.

The frozen first domain is the native canonical ground language, whose reading is unique. Unsupported scope ambiguity remains outside that domain; the wrapper does not silently pick or invent alternatives.
Known clause duplicates and exact source spans remain preserved even if a closure deduplicates atoms.
At the public boundary booleans are rejected in integer fields, integers are rejected in Boolean fields, and canonical-byte comparison is used instead of Python container equality.
Numeric transport has an installed domain and version, exact framing, a bit-length preflight, strict UTF-8, bounded depth and byte sizes, duplicate-key rejection, and exact re-encoding equality.

Whitespace, escaped duplicate keys, signed zero, exponent or fractional numeric spellings, wrong framing, wrong domain/version, leading numeric padding and trailing bytes cannot masquerade as the canonical numeric payload.

The new source-bound/fold API's native timeout is an exact integer from 1 through 60 seconds, default 20, for each native invocation. A Boolean or fractional timeout is invalid; existing owners retain their prior interfaces. The budget is included in replay identity.
Resource exhaustion is not UNKNOWN, REFUTED, negative evidence or a proof of no derivation; outer budgets cannot override the native reader's own finite limits.

Round-trip preserves the entire validated request and evidence. Replay equality is scoped to the same independent request, current evidence and installed checking environment; it is not a general theorem about Arabic or external truth.
non_goals: No parallel reader, Horn kernel, qualified-guard classifier, general truth-maintenance engine or new proof authority; no newly admitted caller-assumption bridge branch.
No Phi elimination, approximate compression, general ambiguity parser, automatic causal-role acquisition or rule-adoption bridge.
No claim that source-relative support proves world truth, validates source authenticity, establishes rule adoption or authorizes an action.
No claim of a new Lean theorem solely from these finite tests.
